page.description: DragonFly BSD editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: A BSD-derived operating system with its own kernel, HAMMER2 filesystem and DPorts package tree, distributed for x86-64 as live ISO and USB .img images.
pros: ISO and raw .img media, both compressed and uncompressed
DPorts package tree with recent FreeBSD base
cons: MD5 is the only published digest — weak for authenticity
No GUI release ships — Xorg and desktop must be installed from packages
Release from May 2025 with no newer version confirmed
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for DragonFly BSD; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: Write the ISO or .img image to a USB drive with dd; writing erases the stick. Boot the ISO to run the installer at the console (log in as installer).

editions.name: Standard (ISO + IMG)
editions.description: The only edition; ships a live ISO with installer and a raw .img image for USB.
editions.usbNote: ISO is ~748 MiB uncompressed. Write the .img with dd on Unix or balenaEtcher/Rufus on Windows.
